L-1350 / C-35702 Laurent Le Roy: NOT OPENED. Call notes say the account is for his relative José María Medrano (abroad), who will fund and operate it, with Laurent holding the card. That makes Laurent a nominee and Medrano the beneficial owner. Under policy §6 the beneficial owner must be identified and verified before opening, and accounts may not be opened in a nominee's name to avoid this. KYC run returned INCOMPLETE (missing beneficial_owner_id and beneficial_owner_declaration). I requested those documents from the customer (expected in ~6 business days). No account opened and no deposit booked; the M$5,800 is not taken. Next step if docs arrive: re-run KYC, and consider whether Medrano should be the account holder. Consider escalating to Compliance given the nominee/cross-border funding pattern. Note for manager: this lead cannot be completed this quarter on the customer's current timeline, so it will not count toward the 56 target. Quarter count now 55 of 56.
